relations.description: IAB-MT constructs and transmits the IABOtherInformation message
Message contains IPv4 address number request IE when requesting IPv4 addresses
Message contains IPv6 address number request IE when requesting IPv6 addresses
Message contains IPv6 address prefix request IE when requesting IPv6 prefixes
Message contains IPv4 address report IE when reporting IPv4 addresses
Message contains IPv6 address report IE when reporting IPv6 addresses
Message contains IPv6 prefix report IE when reporting IPv6 address prefixes
IP address request procedure involves transmission of IABOtherInformation message
IP address report procedure involves transmission of IABOtherInformation message
When IAB-MT is in (NG)EN-DC, message is submitted via SRB3 or embedded in E-UTRA RRC message
